title: 傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀
summary: 從干涉圖與傅立葉轉換的關係出發，理解動鏡行程如何決定解析度、氦氖雷射條紋如何定義波數軸與取樣，再把分光鏡、光源、偵測器、光闌與吹掃整合成可驗收的紅外光譜儀；聚苯乙烯標準片與 100% 線測試是全課的量測主軸。
summaryEn: Starting from the interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair, this course shows how mirror travel sets resolution, how HeNe laser fringes define the wavenumber axis and sampling, and how beamsplitter, source, detector, aperture stop and purge combine into an acceptable infrared spectrometer; the polystyrene standard and the 100% line test are the measurement backbone throughout.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對」與「解析度、切趾與通量優勢」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair" and "Resolution, apodization and the throughput advantage": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」如何決定傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Michelson interferometer and interferogram” determines the key performance of “Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: FTIR 不用光柵分光，而是讓紅外光進入麥克森干涉儀：分光鏡把光分成兩路，一路到固定鏡、一路到以等速移動的動鏡，兩路重合後的強度隨光程差 x 變化，形成干涉圖 I(x) = ∫B(ν̃)cos(2πν̃x)dν̃。每個波數 ν̃ 的光在動鏡掃描時都以自己的頻率 f = 2v·ν̃ 被調變（v 為動鏡速度、2v 為光程差速度），所有波數同時被偵測器記錄，再用傅立葉轉換把干涉圖還原成光譜 B(ν̃)。這就是費爾蓋特多工優勢的來源：整個掃描時間內每個波數都在累積訊號，而不是像色散式儀器逐一通過狹縫。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Instead of dispersing light with a grating, an FTIR sends the infrared beam into a Michelson interferometer: the beamsplitter divides it toward a fixed mirror and a mirror moving at constant velocity, and the recombined intensity varies with optical path difference x as the interferogram I(x) = ∫B(ν̃)cos(2πν̃x)dν̃. Each wavenumber ν̃ is modulated at its own audio frequency f = 2v·ν̃ (v the mirror velocity, 2v the path-difference velocity), all wavenumbers reach the detector simultaneously, and a Fourier transform recovers the spectrum B(ν̃). This is the Fellgett multiplex advantage: every spectral element accumulates signal for the whole scan rather than taking turns through a slit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Michelson interferometer and interferogram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取光程差速度 2v = 0.6329 cm/s（常見設定，此處為教學假設），波數 1000 cm⁻¹ 的光被調變在 f = 0.6329×1000 ≈ 633 Hz；4000 cm⁻¹ 在約 2.5 kHz；氦氖參考雷射 15798 cm⁻¹ 則在約 10 kHz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a path-difference velocity 2v = 0.6329 cm/s (a common setting, used here as a teaching assumption), light at 1000 cm⁻¹ is modulated at f = 0.6329×1000 ≈ 633 Hz, 4000 cm⁻¹ at about 2.5 kHz, and the HeNe reference at 15798 cm⁻¹ near 10 kHz; the detector and preamplifier bandwidth must cover this whole audio band or the high-wavenumber end is attenuated.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FTIR 是用某種精密光柵把紅外光分成各個波長後逐一量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An FTIR uses a fine grating to separate the infrared wavelengths and measures them one at a time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Michelson interferometer and interferogram”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：FTIR 是用某種精密光柵把紅外光分成各個波長後逐一量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An FTIR uses a fine grating to separate the infrared wavelengths and measures them one at a time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair" is correct?

動鏡走得越遠，解析度就無限提高，與光闌大小無關。
optionsEn: An FTIR uses a fine grating to separate the infrared wavelengths and measures them one at a time.

Longer mirror travel keeps improving resolution indefinitely, regardless of aperture size.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Michelson interferometer and interferogram” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取光程差速度 2v = 0.6329 cm/s（常見設定，此處為教學假設），波數 1000 cm⁻¹ 的光被調變在 f = 0.6329×1000 ≈ 633 Hz；4000 cm⁻¹ 在約 2.5 kHz；氦氖參考雷射 15798 cm⁻¹ 則在約 10 kHz。偵測器與前置放大器的頻寬必須涵蓋整個音頻帶，否則高波數端會被衰減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a path-difference velocity 2v = 0.6329 cm/s (a common setting, used here as a teaching assumption), light at 1000 cm⁻¹ is modulated at f = 0.6329×1000 ≈ 633 Hz, 4000 cm⁻¹ at about 2.5 kHz, and the HeNe reference at 15798 cm⁻¹ near 10 kHz; the detector and preamplifier bandwidth must cover this whole audio band or the high-wavenumber end is attenuated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在儀器診斷模式觀察干涉圖：中心爆（centre burst）的峰值電壓應落在 ADC 量程的 30–70%，單光束光譜在 2000 cm⁻¹ 附近的能量應與出廠基準相符；接著以示波器或診斷軟體檢查氦氖條紋頻率是否約為 10 kHz，確認動鏡速度與調變頻率的對應關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the instrument diagnostic mode inspect the interferogram: the centre-burst peak should sit at 30–70% of the ADC range, and the single-beam energy near 2000 cm⁻¹ should match the factory baseline; then check with an oscilloscope or the diagnostic software that the HeNe fringe frequency is close to 10 kHz, confirming the mirror velocity and the modulation-frequency mapping.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair", which statement holds?
options: 氦氖雷射只是幫動鏡對準用的，對波數準確度沒有影響。

取光程差速度 2v = 0.6329 cm/s（常見設定，此處為教學假設），波數 1000 cm⁻¹ 的光被調變在 f = 0.6329×1000 ≈ 633 Hz。

Higher resolution always gives a better spectrum, and scan averaging is merely cosmetic.

steps.title: 干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Michelson interferometer and interferogram” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在儀器診斷模式觀察干涉圖：中心爆（centre burst）的峰值電壓應落在 ADC 量程的 30–70%，單光束光譜在 2000 cm⁻¹ 附近的能量應與出廠基準相符；接著以示波器或診斷軟體檢查氦氖條紋頻率是否約為 10 kHz，確認動鏡速度與調變頻率的對應關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the instrument diagnostic mode inspect the interferogram: the centre-burst peak should sit at 30–70% of the ADC range, and the single-beam energy near 2000 cm⁻¹ should match the factory baseline; then check with an oscilloscope or the diagnostic software that the HeNe fringe frequency is close to 10 kHz, confirming the mirror velocity and the modulation-frequency mapping. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若動鏡速度設定高於 DTGS 偵測器的響應頻寬，高波數端訊號會被偵測器的低通特性壓低，單光束光譜在 4000 cm⁻¹ 附近塌陷，使用者誤以為是光源老化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the mirror velocity is set above the DTGS detector's response bandwidth, the detector's low-pass behaviour suppresses the high-wavenumber end, the single-beam spectrum collapses near 4000 cm⁻¹, and users wrongly blame an aging source.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在儀器診斷模式觀察干涉圖：中心爆（centre burst）的峰值電壓應落在 ADC 量程的 30–70%，單光束光譜在 2000 cm⁻¹ 附近的能量應與出廠基準相符；接著以示波器或診斷軟體檢查氦氖條紋頻率是否約為 10 kHz，確認動鏡速度與調變頻率的對應關係。
knowledge.textEn: In the instrument diagnostic mode inspect the interferogram: the centre-burst peak should sit at 30–70% of the ADC range, and the single-beam energy near 2000 cm⁻¹ should match the factory baseline; then check with an oscilloscope or the diagnostic software that the HeNe fringe frequency is close to 10 kHz, confirming the mirror velocity and the modulation-frequency mapping.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair"?
options: 在儀器診斷模式觀察干涉圖：中心爆（centre burst）的峰值電壓應落在 ADC 量程的 30–70%，單光束光譜在 2000 cm⁻¹ 附近的能量應與出廠基準相符。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要樣品與背景在同一天量測，水氣與 CO₂ 就會完全相消。
optionsEn: In the instrument diagnostic mode inspect the interferogram: the centre-burst peak should sit at 30–70% of the ADC range, and the single-beam energy near 2000 cm⁻¹ should match the factory baseline.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
As long as sample and background are measured on the same day, water vapour and CO₂ cancel completely.
quiz.explanation: 在儀器診斷模式觀察干涉圖：中心爆（centre burst）的峰值電壓應落在 ADC 量程的 30–70%，單光束光譜在 2000 cm⁻¹ 附近的能量應與出廠基準相符；接著以示波器或診斷軟體檢查氦氖條紋頻率是否約為 10 kHz，確認動鏡速度與調變頻率的對應關係。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In the instrument diagnostic mode inspect the interferogram: the centre-burst peak should sit at 30–70% of the ADC range, and the single-beam energy near 2000 cm⁻¹ should match the factory baseline; then check with an oscilloscope or the diagnostic software that the HeNe fringe frequency is close to 10 kHz, confirming the mirror velocity and the modulation-frequency mapping. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Michelson interferometer and interferogram” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若動鏡速度設定高於 DTGS 偵測器的響應頻寬，高波數端訊號會被偵測器的低通特性壓低，單光束光譜在 4000 cm⁻¹ 附近塌陷，使用者誤以為是光源老化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the mirror velocity is set above the DTGS detector's response bandwidth, the detector's low-pass behaviour suppresses the high-wavenumber end, the single-beam spectrum collapses near 4000 cm⁻¹, and users wrongly blame an aging source. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這就是費爾蓋特多工優勢的來源：整個掃描時間內每個波數都在累積訊號，而不是像色散式儀器逐一通過狹縫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is the Fellgett multiplex advantage: every spectral element accumulates signal for the whole scan rather than taking turns through a slit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FTIR 是用某種精密光柵把紅外光分成各個波長後逐一量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An FTIR uses a fine grating to separate the infrared wavelengths and measures them one at a time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若動鏡速度設定高於 DTGS 偵測器的響應頻寬，高波數端訊號會被偵測器的低通特性壓低，單光束光譜在 4000 cm⁻¹ 附近塌陷，使用者誤以為是光源老化。
knowledge.textEn: If the mirror velocity is set above the DTGS detector's response bandwidth, the detector's low-pass behaviour suppresses the high-wavenumber end, the single-beam spectrum collapses near 4000 cm⁻¹, and users wrongly blame an aging source.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 解析度、切趾與通量優勢：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Resolution, apodization and the throughput advantage: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「動鏡行程與雅基諾光闌」如何決定傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mirror travel and the Jacquinot stop” determines the key performance of “Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光譜解析度由最大光程差 Δ_max 決定：Δν̃ ≈ 1/Δ_max，動鏡只需移動 Δ_max/2，因為光程差是鏡位移的兩倍。干涉圖在 Δ_max 處被截斷相當於乘上矩形窗，光譜中每條譜線因此帶有 sinc 形的儀器線形與 −22% 的旁瓣；改用三角形等切趾函數可壓低旁瓣，代價是線寬變寬。雅基諾優勢來自干涉儀不需要狹縫：允許的立體角 Ω = 2π/R（R 為解析能力 ν̃_max/Δν̃），遠大於同解析度的光柵儀器，因此可用較大的光闌通過更多能量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動鏡行程與雅基諾光闌」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spectral resolution is fixed by the maximum optical path difference Δ_max through Δν̃ ≈ 1/Δ_max, and the mirror itself travels only Δ_max/2 because path difference is twice the mirror displacement. Truncating the interferogram at Δ_max multiplies it by a boxcar window, so every spectral line carries a sinc instrument line shape with −22% side lobes; a triangular or similar apodization suppresses the side lobes at the cost of a wider line. The Jacquinot advantage arises because an interferometer needs no slit: the admissible solid angle is Ω = 2π/R with R = ν̃_max/Δν̃ the resolving power, far larger than a grating instrument of equal resolution, so a larger stop passes more energy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mirror travel and the Jacquinot stop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：標稱解析度 4 cm⁻¹ 需要 Δ_max = 0.25 cm，動鏡行程 1.25 mm；矩形窗的線寬 FWHM = 0.603/Δ_max = 2.41 cm⁻¹，三角切趾為 0.886/Δ_max = 3.54 cm⁻¹。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A nominal 4 cm⁻¹ resolution needs Δ_max = 0.25 cm, i.e. 1.25 mm of mirror travel; the boxcar line width is FWHM = 0.603/Δ_max = 2.41 cm⁻¹ and triangular apodization gives 0.886/Δ_max = 3.54 cm⁻¹.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動鏡走得越遠，解析度就無限提高，與光闌大小無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Longer mirror travel keeps improving resolution indefinitely, regardless of aperture size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「動鏡行程與雅基諾光闌」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Mirror travel and the Jacquinot stop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 解析度、切趾與通量優勢
knowledge.titleEn: Resolution, apodization and the throughput advantage

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：動鏡走得越遠，解析度就無限提高，與光闌大小無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「解析度、切趾與通量優勢」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Longer mirror travel keeps improving resolution indefinitely, regardless of aperture size.
An MCT detector is better than DTGS in every situation, so MCT should always be used.
Spectral resolution is fixed by the maximum optical path difference Δ_max through Δν̃ ≈ 1/Δ_max, and the mirror itself travels only Δ_max/2 because path difference is twice the mirror displacement.
quiz.explanation: 光譜解析度由最大光程差 Δ_max 決定：Δν̃ ≈ 1/Δ_max，動鏡只需移動 Δ_max/2，因為光程差是鏡位移的兩倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Spectral resolution is fixed by the maximum optical path difference Δ_max through Δν̃ ≈ 1/Δ_max, and the mirror itself travels only Δ_max/2 because path difference is twice the mirror displacement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 解析度、切趾與通量優勢：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resolution, apodization and the throughput advantage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動鏡行程與雅基諾光闌」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mirror travel and the Jacquinot stop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：標稱解析度 4 cm⁻¹ 需要 Δ_max = 0.25 cm，動鏡行程 1.25 mm；矩形窗的線寬 FWHM = 0.603/Δ_max = 2.41 cm⁻¹，三角切趾為 0.886/Δ_max = 3.54 cm⁻¹。雅基諾光闌：R = 4000/4 = 1000，Ω = 2π/1000 = 6.28×10⁻³ sr，半角 θ = √(Ω/π) = 0.0447 rad（2.56°）；若準直鏡焦距 100 mm，光闌直徑 = 2fθ ≈ 8.9 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A nominal 4 cm⁻¹ resolution needs Δ_max = 0.25 cm, i.e. 1.25 mm of mirror travel; the boxcar line width is FWHM = 0.603/Δ_max = 2.41 cm⁻¹ and triangular apodization gives 0.886/Δ_max = 3.54 cm⁻¹. For the Jacquinot stop, R = 4000/4 = 1000, Ω = 2π/1000 = 6.28×10⁻³ sr, half-angle θ = √(Ω/π) = 0.0447 rad (2.56°); with a 100 mm collimator focal length the stop diameter is 2fθ ≈ 8.9 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測低壓氣體（如 CO 或 HCl）的窄轉動譜線或聚苯乙烯 2851/2870 cm⁻¹ 這一對譜線：比較矩形窗與三角切趾下的線寬與旁瓣，確認 FWHM 符合 0.603/Δ_max 與 0.886/Δ_max 的預測；再逐級縮小光闌，觀察單光束能量按光闌面積下降而線寬不再改善。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure narrow rotational lines of a low-pressure gas such as CO or HCl, or the polystyrene 2851/2870 cm⁻¹ pair, and compare line width and side lobes under boxcar and triangular apodization against the 0.603/Δ_max and 0.886/Δ_max predictions; then close the aperture step by step and confirm that single-beam energy falls with stop area while the line width stops improving.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 標稱解析度 4 cm⁻¹ 需要 Δ_max = 0.25 cm，動鏡行程 1.25 mm；矩形窗的線寬 FWHM = 0.603/Δ_max = 2.41 cm⁻¹，三角切趾為 0.886/Δ_max = 3.54 cm⁻¹。雅基諾光闌：R = 4000/4 = 1000，Ω = 2π/1000 = 6.28×10⁻³ sr，半角 θ = √(Ω/π) = 0.0447 rad（2.56°）；若準直鏡焦距 100 mm，光闌直徑 = 2fθ ≈ 8.9 mm。
knowledge.textEn: A nominal 4 cm⁻¹ resolution needs Δ_max = 0.25 cm, i.e. 1.25 mm of mirror travel; the boxcar line width is FWHM = 0.603/Δ_max = 2.41 cm⁻¹ and triangular apodization gives 0.886/Δ_max = 3.54 cm⁻¹. For the Jacquinot stop, R = 4000/4 = 1000, Ω = 2π/1000 = 6.28×10⁻³ sr, half-angle θ = √(Ω/π) = 0.0447 rad (2.56°); with a 100 mm collimator focal length the stop diameter is 2fθ ≈ 8.9 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.explanationEn: A nominal 4 cm⁻¹ resolution needs Δ_max = 0.25 cm, i.e. 1.25 mm of mirror travel; the boxcar line width is FWHM = 0.603/Δ_max = 2.41 cm⁻¹ and triangular apodization gives 0.886/Δ_max = 3.54 cm⁻¹. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 解析度、切趾與通量優勢：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resolution, apodization and the throughput advantage: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「動鏡行程與雅基諾光闌」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Mirror travel and the Jacquinot stop” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量測低壓氣體（如 CO 或 HCl）的窄轉動譜線或聚苯乙烯 2851/2870 cm⁻¹ 這一對譜線：比較矩形窗與三角切趾下的線寬與旁瓣，確認 FWHM 符合 0.603/Δ_max 與 0.886/Δ_max 的預測；再逐級縮小光闌，觀察單光束能量按光闌面積下降而線寬不再改善。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure narrow rotational lines of a low-pressure gas such as CO or HCl, or the polystyrene 2851/2870 cm⁻¹ pair, and compare line width and side lobes under boxcar and triangular apodization against the 0.603/Δ_max and 0.886/Δ_max predictions; then close the aperture step by step and confirm that single-beam energy falls with stop area while the line width stops improving. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了追求 0.5 cm⁻¹ 解析度卻沒有縮小光闌，離軸光線的光程差縮短使譜線變寬、峰位偏移，解析度實際達不到標稱值；反之光闌太小又讓訊雜比下降到無法使用。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Chasing 0.5 cm⁻¹ resolution without closing the aperture lets off-axis rays with shortened path difference broaden and shift the lines so the nominal resolution is never reached; closing the stop too far instead drives the signal-to-noise ratio below usability.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測低壓氣體（如 CO 或 HCl）的窄轉動譜線或聚苯乙烯 2851/2870 cm⁻¹ 這一對譜線：比較矩形窗與三角切趾下的線寬與旁瓣，確認 FWHM 符合 0.603/Δ_max 與 0.886/Δ_max 的預測；再逐級縮小光闌，觀察單光束能量按光闌面積下降而線寬不再改善。
knowledge.textEn: Measure narrow rotational lines of a low-pressure gas such as CO or HCl, or the polystyrene 2851/2870 cm⁻¹ pair, and compare line width and side lobes under boxcar and triangular apodization against the 0.603/Δ_max and 0.886/Δ_max predictions; then close the aperture step by step and confirm that single-beam energy falls with stop area while the line width stops improving.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「解析度、切趾與通量優勢」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Resolution, apodization and the throughput advantage"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
量測低壓氣體（如 CO 或 HCl）的窄轉動譜線或聚苯乙烯 2851/2870 cm⁻¹ 這一對譜線：比較矩形窗與三角切趾下的線寬與旁瓣，確認 FWHM 符合 0.603/Δ_max 與 0.886/Δ_max 的預測。
儀器自我診斷顯示綠燈，就等於通過性能驗證。

quiz.explanationEn: Measure narrow rotational lines of a low-pressure gas such as CO or HCl, or the polystyrene 2851/2870 cm⁻¹ pair, and compare line width and side lobes under boxcar and triangular apodization against the 0.603/Δ_max and 0.886/Δ_max predictions; then close the aperture step by step and confirm that single-beam energy falls with stop area while the line width stops improving. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 解析度、切趾與通量優勢：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Resolution, apodization and the throughput advantage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動鏡行程與雅基諾光闌」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Mirror travel and the Jacquinot stop” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了追求 0.5 cm⁻¹ 解析度卻沒有縮小光闌，離軸光線的光程差縮短使譜線變寬、峰位偏移，解析度實際達不到標稱值；反之光闌太小又讓訊雜比下降到無法使用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Chasing 0.5 cm⁻¹ resolution without closing the aperture lets off-axis rays with shortened path difference broaden and shift the lines so the nominal resolution is never reached; closing the stop too far instead drives the signal-to-noise ratio below usability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雅基諾優勢來自干涉儀不需要狹縫：允許的立體角 Ω = 2π/R（R 為解析能力 ν̃_max/Δν̃），遠大於同解析度的光柵儀器，因此可用較大的光闌通過更多能量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Jacquinot advantage arises because an interferometer needs no slit: the admissible solid angle is Ω = 2π/R with R = ν̃_max/Δν̃ the resolving power, far larger than a grating instrument of equal resolution, so a larger stop passes more energy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「動鏡走得越遠，解析度就無限提高，與光闌大小無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Longer mirror travel keeps improving resolution indefinitely, regardless of aperture size." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了追求 0.5 cm⁻¹ 解析度卻沒有縮小光闌，離軸光線的光程差縮短使譜線變寬、峰位偏移，解析度實際達不到標稱值；反之光闌太小又讓訊雜比下降到無法使用。
knowledge.textEn: Chasing 0.5 cm⁻¹ resolution without closing the aperture lets off-axis rays with shortened path difference broaden and shift the lines so the nominal resolution is never reached; closing the stop too far instead drives the signal-to-noise ratio below usability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「解析度、切趾與通量優勢」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Resolution, apodization and the throughput advantage" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
MCT 偵測器在任何情況下都優於 DTGS，所以應該永遠使用 MCT。
為了追求 0.5 cm⁻¹ 解析度卻沒有縮小光闌，離軸光線的光程差縮短使譜線變寬、峰位偏移，解析度實際達不到標稱值；反之光闌太小又讓訊雜比下降到無法使用。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An MCT detector is better than DTGS in every situation, so MCT should always be used.
Chasing 0.5 cm⁻¹ resolution without closing the aperture lets off-axis rays with shortened path difference broaden and shift the lines so the nominal resolution is never reached.
quiz.explanation: 為了追求 0.5 cm⁻¹ 解析度卻沒有縮小光闌，離軸光線的光程差縮短使譜線變寬、峰位偏移，解析度實際達不到標稱值；反之光闌太小又讓訊雜比下降到無法使用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Chasing 0.5 cm⁻¹ resolution without closing the aperture lets off-axis rays with shortened path difference broaden and shift the lines so the nominal resolution is never reached; closing the stop too far instead drives the signal-to-noise ratio below usability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
